<thought>We need to run the get_adsorption_sites_text tool on the CIF content of the chosen slab. The CIF string must be provided with newline characters escaped as \n so the tool can parse it correctly. After obtaining the JSON output of adsorption sites, we will write it to a file named adsorption_sites.json and then return the file path.</thought>
<action>get_adsorption_sites_text</action>
